title: Swayve plugin manifest
description: Structure of a Swayve plugin's plugin.json. schemaVersion 3 (a schemaVersion 1 or 2 manifest also validates). This file is the published contract; cross-field rules that a JSON Schema cannot express live in swayve_plugin_tools and are documented in schema/README.md.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema version this plugin.json is written in. Currently 2; a manifest declaring 1 is still valid.

id.description: Globally unique reverse-DNS plugin id, at least three segments.

name.description: Human readable plugin name. No emoji.

description.description: One paragraph describing what the plugin adds to Swayve.

license.description: SPDX licence identifier, for example Apache-2.0.

swayvePluginApi.description: SDK major API level this plugin targets. v1 plugins declare 1.

minimumSwayveVersion.description: Lowest Swayve client version this plugin runs on.

runtime.description: How the plugin reaches the device.

permissions.description: Host facilities the plugin is allowed to touch. May be empty.

entrypoint.description: Dart library / registration symbol the host resolves. Also the plugin's directory name.

icon.description: Relative path to the plugin icon, inside assets/, png or svg.

source.description: How this plugin presents itself as a place a query can be sent. Optional: a plugin that only enriches what the host already has is not a source.

media.description: What the plugin claims it can do with media. Three independent facts.

settings.description: Settings the host renders on the plugin's behalf.

network.description: Outbound network the plugin declares up front.

timeouts.description: Plugin-requested timeout budget. The host still applies its own hard limits.

semver.$comment: Strict SemVer 2.0.0, the regex published at semver.org.

pluginId.$comment: Reverse-DNS, three or more lowercase segments.

assetPath.$comment: Relative, inside assets/, no traversal, no drive letter, no backslash.

hostPattern.$comment: A hostname, optionally with a single leading *. wildcard label.

sourceId.$comment: The identity a person's saved source selection is keyed on. Distinct from the plugin id: that identifies a package, this identifies a place music comes from.

iconName.$comment: A glyph name the host resolves from its own icon set, not a path and not a shipped asset. An unknown name falls back to a generic source mark.

contentType.description: Closed vocabulary of what a source can be asked for.

sourceAvailability.description: Closed vocabulary of whether a source can answer. In a manifest this is a declared default, not an observation: whether a service can answer right now is knowable only to a running plugin.

capability.description: Closed capability vocabulary. Each entry maps to exactly one provider interface.

permission.description: Closed permission vocabulary. Anything not listed is not grantable in v1.

runtime.description: compiled ships inside a Swayve build; bundled is a .swayveplugin loaded at runtime and is not permitted on iOS.

source.$comment: Everything here except the identity is optional, and the whole object is optional. What a source can be asked for is declared rather than derived from the capability list: a catalog provider for a service built on user uploads has no albums to offer however firmly it declares catalog.

displayName.description: What a person calls the service. Names the service, not the plugin. No emoji.

contentTypes.description: What this source can be asked for. Empty means it publishes a catalogue but is not worth putting a query to.

media.$comment: Streamable, downloadable and offline-cacheable are three independent facts. Never derive one from another.

hosts.description: Outbound hostnames the plugin may reach through the host HTTP client.

requestMs.description: Budget for a single outbound request.

operationMs.description: Budget for a whole provider operation.

settingDescriptor.description: One host-rendered setting. The plugin never renders its own settings page.

options.description: Required for type select, forbidden otherwise.
